# E0360: a lens copies a value its target rejects for some instance

A lens is total: every instance of its source schema translates to an instance
of its target. Copying a field whose target is narrower than its source fails
for the instances the target rejects. Here 0.0 allows any int and 1.0 only
those below 10, so copying `a` forward is not total.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a!: int
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a!: int & <10
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			a: v0_0.a
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0360]: a in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:22:7
   |
22 |             a: v0_0.a
   |                ^^^^
   |
   = note: a in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 copies v0_0.a, which is now int & <10, which does not accept every value of the prior int (compat rule value-narrowed)
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule copy-narrowed)
```
